steps.text: Current I = ΔQ/Δt, measured in amperes; potential difference V = W/Q.
Resistance R = V/I; for an ohmic conductor V = IR with a straight I–V line through the origin.
A diode conducts in one direction only; a filament lamp curves as its resistance rises with temperature.
Electrical power P = VI = I²R = V²/R.
One kilowatt-hour is a unit of energy, equal to 3.6 MJ.
